name: D1 real-model labelling through synthetic propagation
models: Existing real Node YAMNet MediaPipe + quantised CLAP with repository catalogue and classify(clap5); no substitute predictions.
prediction_rule: Classify full node microphone 0 recording. Highest-confidence labelled period wins, earliest period breaks ties. No source windows or labels supplied to classifier. No label counts as incorrect. Compare against pinned ESC-50 manifest accepted labels only after inference.
association: A predicted period associates to a measured fix only if it overlaps accepted windows of that fix's node track. No truth-assisted association. This is a singleton-source study, not validation of separating overlapping classes.
snr: Scoring-only peak detection-band per-source 10ms power over renderer detection-band noise power; never used for inference or normalisation.
oracle: Known source label/presence oracle, not a detector. Oracle/localiser coverage are separate denominators.
reporting: Complete equal populations only, per label/range/noise/normalisation and SNR bins. No classification or hardware ranking from a partial report. Descriptive paired preprocessing experiment, no default change or tuning on outcomes.
limitations: One real ESC-50 clip per label through synthetic simulation is a smoke population, not independent recordings, general model accuracy or real-world propagation validation. Normalisation preserves SNR and may change level-trigger behaviour. No new classifier weights.
